basic_info.description: Situated at the end of a cul-de-sac, this stunning, sun-filled residence in a 2-unit building showcases newly refinished maple hardwood floors, 9.5-foot ceilings, coved ceilings, & intricate moldings creating a timeless elegance. Period hardwood doors, thick baseboards, & bay-style double-pane windows add to the charm & sophistication of this exceptional home. Step outside to the beautifully landscaped, sunlit south-facing garden & backyard a serene oasis perfect for gardening enthusiasts, entertaining guests, or simply relaxing & soaking up the sun. This prime South of Market location offers the perfect blend of urban convenience & modern comfort. Close proximity to fine dining, lively nightlife venues, trendy cafes & easy access to highways 280/101, Muni, Bart, Caltrain & Downtown. 2 bedrooms, home office, one full updated bathroom, entrance hall, living room, dining room, remodeled eat-in kitchen with island, in-unit washer/dryer, one car tandem garage parking, enormous storage area, common storage garage, common landscaped sunny south facing garden/backyard with deck, bench, table, patio, lemon & fig trees, bamboo, mature cacti, blooming flowers, new gravel & mulch, irrigation & raised garden beds with lush greenery, tankless water heater, new wall heaters, Ring doorbell.
